title_zh: 达娃次仁主持召开拉萨市委理论学习中心组集体学习会
title_en: Dawa Ciren Chairs Lhasa Municipal Party Committee Study Session
summary_zh: 9月8日，自治区党委常委、拉萨市委书记达娃次仁主持召开市委理论学习中心组集体学习会，强调深入学习贯彻习近平总书记关于加强和改进民族工作的重要思想。
summary_en: On Sept. 8, Dawa Ciren, standing committee member of CPC Tibet Regional Committee and Lhasa Party chief, hosted a study session calling for implementing Xi Jinping's thought on ethnic work.
